# HIPAA compliant AI scribe

A HIPAA compliant AI medical scribe with BAA available, zero audio retention, and no training on patient data — plus documentation you can verify against extracted clinical facts.

## HIPAA compliance you can actually evaluate

Notat is HIPAA-compliant and a Business Associate Agreement is available for covered entities. Consultation audio is processed in short sequences and deleted immediately; interim data auto-deletes within 24–48 hours; patient data is never used to train models.

## Compliance is more than storage

An AI scribe can store data perfectly and still write things that never happened. The FactsContext™ engine (patent pending) generates documentation from extracted clinical facts and shows the facts to the clinician — so the record is not only protected, it is verifiable.

## Built for practices outside the big-EHR stack

Independent and multi-specialty practices without an Epic-scale IT department get the same compliance posture: BAA, zero audio retention, and self-serve onboarding without a months-long integration project.

### Does Notat sign a BAA?

Yes. A Business Associate Agreement is available for US covered entities and their business associates.

### Is patient audio stored?

No. Audio is processed in short sequences and deleted immediately after processing; interim data auto-deletes within 24–48 hours, and patient data is never used for model training.
